task.question: What operation was involved in the United States seizing tankers in January 2026?
task.evidence: January 7 – The United States seizes two shadow fleet tankers, including one under a Russian flag, in the United States oil blockade during Operation Southern Spear.
task.sonnet_answer: The seizure of tankers in January 2026 was part of US enforcement of sanctions on Iranian oil, connected to the maximum pressure campaign against Iran. The specific operation name I'm not certain of — this may be beyond my reliable knowledge cutoff details.

agent_answer: The U.S. Coast Guard boarded and seized an oil tanker linked to Venezuela for alleged violations of U.S. sanctions.

US seizes Venezuela-linked oil tanker Marinera Skip to main content Home U.S. Politics Sports Entertainment Life Money Tech Travel Opinion Crossword US seized Russia-flagged oil tanker linked to Venezuela over 'sanctions violation' Natalie Neysa Alund USA TODAY Show Caption Hide Caption See thermal video of Coast Guard seizing Venezuela-linked oil tanker The U.S. Coast Guard boarded and seized an oil tanker linked to Venezuela, said the Department of Homeland Security. Following a more than two-week pursuit, U.S. forces on Jan. 7 seized a Venezuela-linked oil tanker escorted by a Russian submarine in the Atlantic Ocean for alleged violations of U.S. sanctions, the Trump administration confirmed. The vessel was seized in the North Atlantic pursuant to a warrant issued by a U.S. federal court after being tracked by the U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Munro, White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt confirmed to reporters during a morning press briefing. U.S. forces had been attempting to board the vessel, named the Marinera, after U.S. leaders said it allegedly fled America’s blockade of sanctioned vessels near Venezuela. "Two oil tankers, two, overnight were seized by the United States of America stateless or sanctioned, because the oil blockade, the quarantine of oil out of unsanctioned or stateless vessels continues," Secretary of War Pete Hegseth told reporters at the U.S. Capitol. "That leverage will continue ... our military is prepared to continue this." So far, there have been no reported injuries to U.S. forces. "We are prepared under the right conditions using the leverage that we have, which includes the fact that they cannot move any oil unless we allow them to move it," U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters during the news conference. The U.S. Coast Guard successfully boarded and seized the oil tanker Marinera after tracking it for more than two weeks.
